messages:
lina (pm): Quick sync on the prompt-sets diff panel 16: compact mode is hard to scan for regressions. Users miss the changed-case highlights and approve affordances. Need layout + copy clarifications.

omar (design): Agreed. Two main pain points: changed tokens are too subtle (light yellow on pale bg) and the approve/ignore actions are visually similar. Proposed: introduce a 2px left accent for changed rows, increase highlight saturation, and make approve a filled button.

kevin (eng): Implementation notes: left-accent is CSS-only (border-left + padding) so cheap. Saturation bump requires token update but okay. Filled button change touches our button component variants  should be fine with a minor release.

mira (a11y): Accessibility concerns: the yellow diff highlight currently fails color-blind checks; prefer using color + pattern or an icon badge (e.g., "Δ") for changes. Also ensure the severity label (regression, minor) is programmatically available with aria-describedby.

omar (design): Good call. I'll add a subtle diagonal hatch pattern overlay (CSS background-image) for changed rows and a left accent in purple token (accessible pairing). Also change the microcopy label from "Changed" to "Modified" to match terminology used elsewhere.

lina (pm): Microcopy discussion: product wants consistency with scorecards. Use "Modified" for inline diffs, and for the approve confirmation modal use "Approve selected runs" not "Approve X items". Also include a one-line consequence sentence in modal.

tess (research): From user tests: reviewers often want to peek at the exact prompt input inline. Can we make the diff expand inline (accordion) rather than navigating to a separate detail page? Users preferred quick expand for small edits.

kevin (eng): Inline expansion is doable but we should limit to one open at a time to avoid memory bloat from rendering many diffs. We'll lazy-render the expanded diff and reuse a diff component. Estimate 3 dev days with tests.

mira (a11y): For the accordion: use role="button" on the toggle, aria-expanded, and ensure expanded content gets role="region" with aria-labelledby. Also keyboard: Enter/Space to toggle, arrow keys to navigate rows.

omar (design): I'll add an affordance chevron and a visible focus ring. Also the approve button will move out of the overflow into the row actions when a row is expanded, so users can approve while viewing the diff.

lina (pm): Decision: implement left accent + pattern + "Modified" label, change approve to filled primary, inline expand with single-open constraint, and update modal copy to "Approve selected runs — this will mark them as approved and trigger no further regression alerts for these runs." Can we get these on a canary?

kevin (eng): I'll branch feature/prompt-diff-ux. Will put the pattern behind a feature flag and include keyboard and aria attributes. PR draft later today.

omar (design): Uploaded comps and added a11y variants to the figma page: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/prompt-diff-ux. Tagged mira for contrast checks.

mira (a11y): I'll run contrast + color-blind sim on the comps. Also request we add a tooltip for the delta badge explaining what changed (e.g., "Prompt text changed: tokens added/removed").

tess (research): I'll schedule 3 followup quick-tests with power reviewers to validate the single-open accordion and approve-in-row flow.

notifier-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary channel receives UI update at 2026-04-02T11:00:00Z if all checks pass.

lina (pm): Thanks all. Action items: kevin PR + flag, omar upload final assets, mira validation, tess user tests. We'll reconvene after canary feedback.

omar (design): One tiny copy nit: change tooltip "Approve run" to include context "Approve run (no further regression alerts)"? Maybe too scary. Lina, thoughts?

lina (pm): Keep tooltip short: "Approve run". Consequences live in the modal copy.

kevin (eng): Noted. Filing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pulse/pull/4188 (WIP).
